description: This file contains a Smarty plugin for the regex_replace modifier, providing functionality to perform regular expression based search and replace operations within templates.

methods.name: smarty_modifier_regex_replace
methods.description: Performs a regex-based search and replace on the input string, supporting search and replace arrays and limiting replacements.

methods.name: _smarty_regex_replace_check
methods.description: Sanitizes the search pattern by removing null bytes and 'eval' modifiers for security.
